Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.builtin

Class TrackerBlockerExtension

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.builtin.TrackerBlockerExtension
All Implemented Interfaces:
BrowserExtension
public final class TrackerBlockerExtension extends Object implements BrowserExtension
A first-party reference extension that vetoes navigations to a small bundled list of well-known tracker/ad hosts, and (when granted Permission.CONTENT_SCRIPT) hides the common ad containers on the rendered page.

The blocklist is intentionally tiny and static — a real deployment would ship and periodically refresh a community list. It demonstrates both a onNavigate veto and a onPageLoaded content-script.
